stages.focus: Three-member parties: mono-type species, STAB and Normal attacks, no held items.
Three-member parties: more mono-types, including Ground, Ghost and Normal immunities.
Three-member parties: dual types, resistances and compounded weaknesses.
Three- and four-member parties: off-type coverage; species alone no longer predicts attacks.
Four-member parties: paralysis, poison, burns or sleep alongside damaging moves.
Four-member parties: recovery, Protect, residual damage and HP management.
Five-member parties: setup, Substitute, Encore, Taunt and stat management.
Five-member parties: weather, hazards, Rapid Spin, phazing and Choice Band.
Six-member parties: curated attacking, defensive and support sets together.
Parties of one to six: broader species, learnable moves, varied stats and held items.
